Title: [lsj] Mind of a Killer obvious question

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
Hi -

Mind of a Killer [KMW:R]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Dementation
+1 stealth action.
[dem] (D) Put this card on a ready minion. This minion gets +1 strength.
*a* Burn this card when a combat involving this minion ends. *b* During
this minion's discard phase, burn this card, and this minion's
controller must inflict 2 damage on another ready minion he or she
controls.
[DEM] As above, and tap this minion when this card is burned.

There are two conditions, *a* and *b*, which can cause this card to
burn. I am wondering if the inflicting of 2 damage only happens if the
card burns due to condition *b*? In other words, if this minion gets
into combat before it's discard phase, it won't have to inflict 2 damage
on another ready minion? I.e. Anatole gets Mind of Killer, freak
drives, then rushes someone with +1 strength.

best -

chris
--
chris shorb

Yes. It isn't "When this card burns, inflict 2 damage...".

Card text: "During this minion's discard phase, ... this minion's
controller must inflict 2 damage on ..."

> In other words, if this minion gets
> into combat before it's discard phase, it won't have to inflict 2 damage
> on another ready minion? I.e. Anatole gets Mind of Killer, freak
> drives, then rushes someone with +1 strength.

Assuming he put Mind of a Killer on Himself, (in order to play Freak),
yeah.
